notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Walk the Aeons on top of your library.
Activate Kefnet the Mindful by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
